label: Ear tip height

provenance.source: species-head-spec.md section 5.4 #36 (measurement family section 5.1, species values section 5.3: puma CT [D], rest [E])

range.endpoint_anchor: ear tip height / L: 0.30 = 0 (neutral base); span 0.80 -> -100 = -0.10, +100 = 1.10 (preset value = 100 x (species ratio - 0.30) / 0.80)

region.mask_rule: ear part placement: tip placed at this height (pivot + carriage compensation vs the palatal line)

semantics: Height of the pinna tip in natural carriage above the palatal line, as a fraction of L - NOT ear length: tip height = base height + length x vertical projection of carriage, so a long ear folded low (badger) and a short ear held upright (bear) share 0.22 L (spec section 5.3). Fennec 1.00 L -> +90, near-pin by the same design that pins EarLength at +100. COMPOSES with EarLength and EarTilt (spec section 5.4): editing tip height moves the pivot/tilt solution; editing length re-solves tilt. No engine coupling kind expresses this placement solve, so the relationship is recorded here rather than as a library/couplings record.
